suppress.notes: Ajent's own ajent-cli Maven artifact is not GitHub CLI. Dependency-Check inferred the unrelated cpe:2.3:a:github:cli identity from the artifact suffix. Keep this scoped to the exact Ajent package and known CVEs.

CVE-2026-53914 affects unsafe deserialization in the Kotlin compiler's build-cache metadata. Ajent contains only kotlin-stdlib as an OkHttp and test-only pty4j runtime dependency; it ships no Kotlin compiler or build cache implementation. Keep this scoped to that runtime artifact and CVE.
